_readme: Manual corrections. Key = the PDF filename (preferred) or the auto slug.
Any field you set here wins over what was auto-extracted from the PDF.
Editable fields: title, client, industries, services, tech, aws,
description, year, hidden (true removes the card from the library),
internal (true shows an INTERNAL ONLY badge and adds a Sharing filter).
Re-run  python3 build.py  after editing this file.
NOTE: internal:true is set on B2Buster below only so you can see what
the badge looks like. Move it to whichever case studies are under NDA.
